description.p: Mithril Viewer is a fast, lightweight image viewer with a clean dark and light interface. It opens PNG, APNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, SVG, AVIF, ICO, TIFF, and QOI files, including animated images.

Mithril Viewer — быстрый и лёгкий просмотрщик изображений с аккуратным тёмным и светлым интерфейсом. Открывает PNG, APNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, SVG, AVIF, ICO, TIFF и QOI, включая анимированные изображения.

ul.li: Smooth cursor-centered zoom, panning, fit-to-window, and fullscreen viewing
Fast folder navigation with background neighbor image prefetching
Quick non-destructive edits: rotation, horizontal/vertical flip, and visual crop
Clipboard copy, CUPS printing, trash/delete confirmation, and set as desktop wallpaper
Drag-and-drop file opening and multi-language interface

description.p: Initial release with broad raster/vector/animated format support, smooth zoom and pan, non-destructive rotate/flip/crop, neighbor prefetching, printing, and wallpaper integration.
